title: Show tooltip with the volume of where the cursor is hovering
line: Hovering a volume slider in the Audio Volume widget shows a tooltip with the volume a click at that spot would set.
explanation: The widget's volume sliders only show the current volume, so picking a precise value with the mouse meant clicking and correcting. Nothing showed what value lay under the pointer. The applet's VolumeSlider now has a hover handler and a tooltip that follows the pointer above the groove and shows the percentage valueAt() gives for that position, hidden while the slider is pressed.

commits.message:
applet: show the hovered volume in a tooltip over the slider

Choosing a precise volume with the mouse meant guessing where to click,
since the slider only shows its current value. A tooltip now follows the
pointer while hovering and shows the volume that a click there would set.

BUG: 526809

media.caption: Pointer over the slider at about 62%: no hint of the value there
Same hover: a tooltip shows 62% above the pointer

review.text: Clean, well-scoped QML implementation in plasma-pa's VolumeSlider that adds a pointer-following tooltip showing the volume percentage under the cursor using Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay and the existing i18nc volume percentage format. The hoveredPosition calculation matches Qt's slider positionAt math, handles horizontal/vertical/mirrored (RTL) layouts and raised maximum volume, and hides while pressed or disabled. Before/after evidence and verification notes are thorough and match the diff.
